Name: Shephatiah, Son of Mattan
Summary: Shephatiah, son of Mattan, was one of the princes who demanded Jeremiah's death, charging that his words weakened the hands of the men of war and all the people.
KeyStory: Shephatiah joined Gedaliah son of Pashur and others in telling Zedekiah that Jeremiah ought to die for weakening the city's hands.
RelatedPeople: Zedekiah, King of Judah; Jeremiah; Gedaliah, Son of Pashur
LifeLesson: Calling a prophet a traitor for telling the truth is a charge that outlives the siege.
